Thanks for looping me in — adding Lauren from Legal/Contracts who will lead the MSA/DPA review on our side. High-level answers: 

- Owner: Lauren Bishop will own the MSA/DPA redline coordination and will be primary contact for Finex legal.
- Turn times: typical first-pass turnaround for standard customers is 3–5 business days for our legal to produce a redline, 5–10 business days if there are third-party hosting or data residency concerns.
